correctness.rationale: Gaussian complete-sketch regression gives the exact independent chi-square quotient and inverse-moment threshold. Positive barycentric Chebyshev nodes prove equality for every k. The global discrete optimization is justified by a uniform exponential bound that confines minimizers to finitely many reserves, with exact integral tie analysis. Verifier replayed from current package paths.

value.rationale: Fixed-row randomized Krylov design entails opposing polynomial-decay and inverse-Wishart amplification terms, making the exact optimal integer allocation structurally meaningful. The sharp reserve (~sqrt(K)/4) and infinite-mean edge identify real mathematical boundaries not captured by deterministic Chebyshev or Gaussian risk statements alone.
